name: amplana-codex
description: Spec-driven development workflows for Codex with guided interviews and adaptive multi-agent execution.

interface.shortDescription: Turn decided requirements into agent-ready specs, then execute them with adaptive agent teams.
interface.longDescription: Amplana adds two Codex-native workflows: amplana:brief turns requirements you have already decided into a structured, agent-ready spec through focused questions and codebase research, and amplana:work assesses complexity, decomposes tasks, and runs solo or multi-agent execution tiers.
defaultPrompt: Use Amplana to brief a feature I have already decided on.
Use Amplana to execute an approved technical spec.
Use Amplana work mode with agent teams for this spec.
